complete_sentence_decision.reason: The inventory locates every editorial word but leaves ordinary connected-letter boundaries, literal-versus-ligature expansions and attachment ownership unresolved. A word-complete writer would currently obtain letter information from the edition or word identity rather than independently observed carriers.
local_retention: Two compact note occurrences in the two editorial καί positions
A medial epsilon-like carrier in the mixed σύμμετρον position with nearby small marks
Ordinary-letter clusters in the other registered word positions
not_new_independent_rule: Exact μ multiplicity and under-dot ownership
complete_sentence_decision.channel_consequence: Retain the known mixed source mechanism and partial local correspondences. Do not calibrate a complete shared spelling channel from this packet, nominate a target key, or count any Voynich meaning.
